lines.en: label yumidorm15:
I knock on the door and make the executive decision to, once again, not say anything.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，并做出了一个果断的决定——再一次，什么也不说。

lines.en: "Yumi and I have been on better terms as of late, but it’s still inherently clear
lines.zh: 「最近我和 Yumi 的关系好了一些，但有一点依然明摆着——

lines.en: that she hates my guts."
lines.zh: 她打心眼里恨我。」

lines.en: "Which is fine, don’t get me wrong. But it does make for
lines.zh: 「这没什么，别误会。只不过在这种时候，

lines.en: slightly more boring narration during times like that."
lines.zh: 旁白确实会稍微无聊一点。」

lines.en: : Yeah? What do you want?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？你想怎样？

lines.en: : I have a-
lines.zh: : 我有一个——

lines.en: : Say one thing about a fuckin’ pizza delivery and I swear to God I’ll rip your nuts off.
lines.zh: : 你他妈敢提一句披萨外卖，我发誓我把你的卵蛋扯下来。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Did somebody order...Chinese food?
lines.zh: : 请问是有人点了……中餐吗？

lines.en: : Just fucking come in. The door’s open...
lines.zh: : 进来吧，操。门开着……

lines.en: : Deal. But only because you asked me to.
lines.zh: : 成交。不过只因为是你让我进的。

lines.en: scene black
I turn the handle...
lines.zh: 我转动门把手……

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive1
And Yumi’s theme song immediately starts playing in my head.
lines.zh: 而 Yumi 的主题曲立刻在我脑海里响了起来。

lines.en: : Why does it have to be so loud, though?
lines.zh: : 不过为什么非得这么吵？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive2
: Huh? The fuck are you talking about? I don’t even have any music on.
lines.zh: : 哈？你在他妈的说什么？我根本没放音乐。

lines.en: : It’s the- Oh, never mind. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 是那个——哦，算了。你在忙什么？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive1
: Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没忙什么。

lines.en: : Cool, cool.
lines.zh: : 挺好，挺好。

lines.en: : This is the part where you ask me what I’m up to. Or how my day went. Or literally anything.
lines.zh: : 这时候你该问我最近在忙什么。或者我今天过得怎么样。或者随便什么。

lines.en: : Just ask me a god damn question, Yumi. I can’t carry every conversation.
lines.zh: : 随便问个该死的问题就行，Yumi。我可没法一个人撑起每一次对话。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive3
: Ugh...fine. Uhh...
lines.zh: : 唉……行吧。呃……

lines.en: : I don't fuckin' know, man. Gimme a sec to think of one.
lines.zh: : 我他妈不知道啊，老兄。给我一点时间想一个。

lines.en: : Sure. You can have all the secs you want.
lines.zh: : 好。你要多久都行。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive4
: Okay, here's a good one- why are you so fucking annoying?
lines.zh: : 行，这个不错——你为什么这么他妈的烦人？

lines.en: : I kind of asked for that one, didn't I?
lines.zh: : 这个算我自找的，是吧？

lines.en: : Yes. And also, fuck you.
lines.zh: : 是的。另外，操你的。

lines.en: : I really don’t appreciate insults at this stage of our relationship, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 在我们这种关系阶段，我真的不太欣赏被骂，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive2
: What stage do you think we’re at, douchebag?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们到哪个阶段了，蠢货？

lines.en: : All I did was sign some stupid paper that said you need to buy me free lunch.
lines.zh: : 我只是签了张破纸，说你得请我吃免费的午饭。

lines.en: s "You’re leaving out the most important part of the contract...getting you a job
lines.zh: 「你漏掉了合同里最重要的部分……给你找份工作，

lines.en: so you don’t have to sell stolen TVs to people."
lines.zh: 这样你就不用把偷来的电视卖给人家了。」

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive5
: Was that really part of the deal? Can’t say I remember it if it was.
lines.zh: : 那也算协议的一部分吗？如果算，我可记不得了。

lines.en: : Hey, if you don’t want to hold up your end of the bargain, I’m perfectly fine walking away from this.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要是不想履行你那份协议，我完全乐意拍拍屁股走人。

lines.en: : Cool. Walk away then.
lines.zh: : 好啊。那你走啊。

lines.en: : Okay, I kind of expected you to try and stop me there, but I guess not.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我多少以为你会试着拦我一下，看来没有。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive2
: Yeah. You expect a lot of weird shit, don't you?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你期待的怪事还真多，是吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I don't know if I'd say a lot.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我不知道算不算多。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive5
: Well...it’s whatever. You haven’t really done anything shitty today so I guess the least I can do is...humor you for a little while.
lines.zh: : 行吧……随便怎样。你今天没干什么混账事，所以我想我至少能……陪你乐呵一会儿。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive6
: I’m guessing you came here to talk about that work thing?
lines.zh: : 我猜你来这儿是想聊找工作那件事？

lines.en: : Not specifically, but I guess we might as well since we’re already on the topic.
lines.zh: : 倒也不全是，不过既然聊到这儿了，说说也无妨。

lines.en: : Is there anywhere you’re interested in working, Yumi? Or maybe some job you’d like to try out?
lines.zh: : Yumi，有没有什么地方是你想去工作的？或者有什么工作你想试试？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive7
: I get to choose?
lines.zh: : 我可以自己选？

lines.en: : Did you think I was going to just bring you to random places until one of them hired you?
lines.zh: : 你以为我会随便带你到处乱转，直到有哪家要你？

lines.en: : Kinda, yeah. I didn’t think there’d be any actual effort involved on my part.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，是啊。我没想到我自己还得付出什么实际的努力。

lines.en: : You’re going to need to put effort into more than just choosing a place to apply to if you really want to earn money.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想赚钱，需要付出努力的可不只是挑个地方投简历这件事。

lines.en: : Not that you were really putting any effort into that aspect of the search either, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 虽说你在找工作这件事上本来也没怎么出力，不过，就这样吧。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive8
: You're forgetting that I don't even fuckin' know how to put this effort shit in! Aren't my options as a teenager like, fuckin' limited or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你忘了我他妈连怎么“努力”都不知道！我一个十几岁的人，选择本来就他妈的有限之类的吧？

lines.en: : The fuck you want me to do? Walk around town and think of all the places that might be lookin' for someone my age?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈想让我干嘛？满镇子走一圈，去想哪些地方可能在招我这个年纪的人？！

lines.en: : That is...exactly what I want you to do. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 那正是……我想让你做的事。对。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive5
: Just...fucking choose a place, dude. I don’t really care. I told you I’m just in it for the free food.
lines.zh: : 你他妈干脆自己选个地方吧，老兄。我真不在乎。我说过了，我就是冲着免费的食物来的。

lines.en: : Then...how about something like a maid cafe?
lines.zh: : 那……女仆咖啡厅之类的怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive9
"Yumi elects to not say anything at all, filling the room with an awkwardly
lines.zh: 「Yumi 决定一句话都不说，让房间里充满了一种尴尬而

lines.en: tense silence that would be sure to make me sweat if I wasn’t twice her size."
lines.zh: 紧绷的沉默——要不是我个头有她两倍大，那沉默准能让我冒汗。」

lines.en: : The fuck did you just say to me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才跟我说什么？

lines.en: : I asked if you’d want to work somewhere like-
lines.zh: : 我问你想不想去类似——

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive10
: I KNOW WHAT YOU FUCKING SAID!
lines.zh: : 我他妈知道你说了什么！

lines.en: : Well, then why did you ask?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要问？

lines.en: : BECAUSE I’M NOT FUCKING OKAY WITH WORKING AT A MAID CAFE! LOOK AT ME!
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈才不要去女仆咖啡厅打工！你看看我！

lines.en: : DO I LOOK LIKE MAID CAFE MATERIAL?!
lines.zh: : 我看起来像是干女仆咖啡厅的料吗？！

lines.en: : It sounds to me like someone doesn't understand both the allure and archetypical diversity of maid cafes.
lines.zh: : 听起来，有人既不理解女仆咖啡厅的魅力，也不理解它那套典型角色的多样性。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive11
: Arca-what? Fuck does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 典型个什么？那他妈是什么意思？

lines.en: : Like, can you actually imagine me dressing up in that kinda shit?
lines.zh: : 我说，你真的能想象我穿上那种破玩意儿的样子？

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I've been imagining it for a few minutes now.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我已经想象了好几分钟了。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive10
: WELL STOP! THAT’S NOT A THING ANYONE SHOULD EVER THINK OF.
lines.zh: : 那就给我停下！那不是任何人该想的东西。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive8
: Now give me a fucking real suggestion before I...rip up your God damn contract or whatever.
lines.zh: : 在我把你的合同什么的撕烂之前，给我一个他妈的正经建议。

lines.en: I think for a moment about places that might be hiring a part-timer...
lines.zh: 我思考了一会儿，哪些地方可能会招兼职……

lines.en: Somewhere that wouldn’t mind taking on someone like Yumi.
lines.zh: 哪些地方不会介意接收 Yumi 这样的人。

lines.en: And before long-
lines.zh: 而没过多久——

lines.en: I realize that I have absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 我意识到我脑子里一片空白。

lines.en: Well, next to nothing.
lines.zh: 好吧，基本上一片空白。

lines.en: The truth is that there is one place I can think of, but I don't really have any idea if they're hiring or not.
lines.zh: 事实上，我能想到的只有一个地方，但我完全不知道他们有没有在招人。

lines.en: I guess it wouldn't hurt as a suggestion, though, when the worst case scenario would just be the two of us going somewhere else.
lines.zh: 不过提一嘴应该也不亏，大不了我们俩再换别的地方。

lines.en: : Okay...How about something like-
lines.zh: : 好吧……那比如说——

lines.en: : A cafe?
lines.zh: : 一家咖啡厅？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive7
: A cafe?
lines.zh: : 咖啡厅？

lines.en: : A cafe.
lines.zh: : 咖啡厅。

lines.en: : With or without maids?
lines.zh: : 有女仆的还是没女仆的？

lines.en: : Without. Even I know better than to suggest the same thing twice in a row.
lines.zh: : 没女仆的。我还不至于蠢到连着两次建议同一件事。

lines.en: : A cafe, huh?...
lines.zh: : 咖啡厅啊，嗯……

lines.en: : You mean like the one Headphones works at?
lines.zh: : 你是说 Headphones 打工的那家？

lines.en: : Headphones? Who is- oh. Rin.
lines.zh: : Headphones？谁是——哦。Rin。

lines.en: : Yeah. Headphones.
lines.zh: : 对。Headphones。

lines.en: : The one who’s always starin’ at Chika and shit.
lines.zh: : 就是那个老是盯着 Chika 看之类的家伙。

lines.en: : So I take it you've noticed that.
lines.zh: : 看来你已经注意到了。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive2
: Fuck yeah I've noticed that. If it’s somethin’ she’s tryin’ to hide then she’s doin’ a piss-poor job. I barely even come to[school] and I noticed.
lines.zh: : 我操，当然注意到了。如果她想瞒着，那她瞒得真他妈烂。我几乎都不去[school]都注意到了。

lines.en: : That’s...relatively worrying. But yes, the one that Rin works at.
lines.zh: : 这……还挺让人担心的。不过对，就是 Rin 打工的那家。

lines.en: : She seems to like her job. And I can’t imagine being a barista is all that hard.
lines.zh: : 她看起来挺喜欢那份工作。而且我想，咖啡师也没那么难当。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive5
: Don’t they have to memorize all those fuckin’ confusing-ass drinks, though?
lines.zh: : 可他们不是得背下那些他妈的乱七八糟的饮料吗？

lines.en: : My memory kinda sucks, not gonna lie. Can’t even remember what I ate for breakfast today.
lines.zh: : 我记性有点差，说实话。连今天早饭吃了什么都想不起来。

lines.en: : Probably nothing because you can’t afford breakfast.
lines.zh: : 大概什么都没吃吧，因为你买不起早饭。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive9
: Hey. Watch your fucking mouth, dick.
lines.zh: : 喂。管好你那张嘴，混蛋。

lines.en: : Just because I don’t have money doesn’t mean you get to fuckin’ tease me about it.
lines.zh: : 我没钱，不代表你他妈的就能拿这个取笑我。

lines.en: : I’m not teasing you. Just trying to motivate you to turn things around.
lines.zh: : 我不是在取笑你。只是想激励你把局面扭转过来。

lines.en: : The sooner you get a job, the sooner you get to start buying things to improve your life.
lines.zh: : 你越早找到工作，就能越早开始买点东西改善生活。

lines.en: if day79 == True:
s "For example, wouldn’t you feel good about yourself if you managed
lines.zh: 「比如说，要是你能攒够钱给 Chinami 买件礼物什么的，

lines.en: to save up enough to buy Chinami a present or something?"
lines.zh: 你自己难道不会觉得舒服一点吗？」

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive12
: Oh, give me a fuckin’ break...Do you really need to bring her into this? That shit ain’t fair.
lines.zh: : 哦，饶了我吧……你非得把她扯进来吗？这招不公平。

lines.en: : You’d have to be a heartless fuck to not have a weak spot for that little twerp.
lines.zh: : 除非是个没心没肺的混蛋，否则谁会对那个小鬼头没点软肋。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive13
: Hey...the fuck you gettin’ all quiet for?
lines.zh: : 喂……你怎么突然不说话了？

lines.en: : No reason. It’s just rare to see you actually show that you care about someone.
lines.zh: : 没什么。只是很少见到你真的表现出在乎某个人。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive12
: Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是啊，那又怎样……

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 操你的。

lines.en: else:
: For example, wouldn’t it feel good buying a laptop or something like that?
lines.zh: : 比如说，买台笔记本电脑之类的，感觉会不会不错？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive7
: Actually...that would be kinda sweet. I could watch all those badass American action movies I used to watch with my cousin when I was little.
lines.zh: : 其实……那还挺棒的。这样我就能看那些我小时候跟表哥一起看过的、超带劲的美国动作片了。

lines.en: : You watched action movies when you were little?
lines.zh: : 你小时候看动作片？

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive13
: There a problem with that, asshole? Action movies are cool as shit.
lines.zh: : 有问题吗，混蛋？动作片酷毙了。

lines.en: : I didn’t say they weren’t. I just think that might be the first thing I’ve learned about your past.
lines.zh: : 我可没说不酷。我只是觉得，这大概是我了解到的关于你过去的第一件事。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive12
: Well, have fun jotting it down in my page of the weird stalker journal you definitely have.
lines.zh: : 行啊，那你尽管记到你那本肯定存在的变态跟踪狂日记里、属于我那一页上吧。

lines.en: : How do you know about my journal?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我有日记？

lines.en: : Oh, fuck off.
lines.zh: : 哦，滚蛋。

lines.en: : Unless you're not kidding and that shit is actually real.
lines.zh: : 除非你不是开玩笑，那玩意儿是真的。

lines.en: : And if it is, please get the fuck out right now before I puke.
lines.zh: : 如果是真的，趁我还没吐，现在立刻给我滚出去。

lines.en: : Just forget I said anything.
lines.zh: : 当我什么都没说。

lines.en: : So, anyway, is the cafe okay? I never got a clear answer.
lines.zh: : 总之，那家咖啡厅行吗？我还没得到明确答复。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive5
: Hah...
Yumi lets out a sigh and thinks to herself for a moment.
lines.zh: Yumi 叹了口气，自己想了一会儿。

lines.en: I guess she’s decided to stop refuting everything I say and put some actual thought into something for once.
lines.zh: 我猜她决定不再反驳我说的每句话，而是头一回真正花点心思去想某件事。

lines.en: The truth is...I can’t imagine her actually working at the cafe. But it’s a good place to start.
lines.zh: 说实话……我无法想象她真的能在咖啡厅干下去。但这是个不错的起点。

lines.en: Right now, I think a job where Yumi doesn’t have to deal with people is probably the best course of action.
lines.zh: 眼下我觉得，一份不用让 Yumi 跟人打交道的工作，大概才是最合适的方向。

lines.en: But, from what I remember, there aren’t a lot of jobs like that open to girls her age...
lines.zh: 但就我所记得的，适合她这个年纪的女孩、又不用见人的工作并不多……

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道……

lines.en: scene black
"Yumi walks away from me and takes a seat on the bed, grabbing one
lines.zh: 「Yumi 从我身边走开，在床上坐下，抓起

lines.en: of her pillows and pressing it up against her chest."
lines.zh: 一个枕头抱在胸前。」

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive14
: I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我怕……

lines.en: : I don't really think anyone's gonna wanna order from any place I’m workin’.
lines.zh: : 我真不觉得会有人想从我打工的地方点东西。

lines.en: : And I wouldn’t want to fuck up business for that place when they haven't even been open for that long.
lines.zh: : 我也不想把那家店的生意搞砸，毕竟他们开业也没多久。

lines.en: : Plus, I’m not friends with Headphones and I don't want her thinkin' that I'm like, intruding on her turf or some shit.
lines.zh: : 再说，我跟 Headphones 又不是朋友，我不想让她觉得我在侵占她的地盘什么的。

lines.en: : Rin’s not like that. She’s pretty cool with everyone.
lines.zh: : Rin 不是那种人。她对谁都挺随和的。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive15
: What, is she a part of your gross-ass harem too?
lines.zh: : 什么，她也是你那恶心后宫里的一员？

lines.en: : That is a...complicated question.
lines.zh: : 这是个……复杂的问题。

lines.en: : I have no idea what the hell that means but I’m just going to assume you’re fucking her too.
lines.zh: : 我他妈完全不懂那是什么意思，但我直接当你也在操她了。

lines.en: : Yeah, you seem to assume that about everyone.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你好像对谁都这么假设。

lines.en: : Yup. Sometimes I think I’m the only one left with any ounce of self-respect.
lines.zh: : 对。有时候我觉得，我是唯一一个还剩一点点自尊的人。

lines.en: : You and I have kissed, though...
lines.zh: : 可我们接吻过啊……

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive16
: Not because I wanted to, you fucking [rapist]!
lines.zh: : 那又不是我自愿的，你这个该死的[rapist]！

lines.en: : Woah there. Calm down. Can we get back to the cafe thing?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，慢点。冷静。我们能聊回咖啡厅的事吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know, can we?! Or are you just gonna start blurting out more unnecessary shit from the past that I’m still tryin’ to forget about?!
lines.zh: : 我不知道，能吗？！还是说你又要开始往外蹦那些我还想忘掉的、多余的陈年破事？！

lines.en: : I think you should give it a shot.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该试一试。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive17
: I hope you’re talkin’ about the cafe again and not making out with you.
lines.zh: : 我希望你说的是咖啡厅，而不是跟你接吻。

lines.en: I mean...not like I’d be opposed to the latter, but...
lines.zh: 我是说……后者我也不是不乐意，不过……

lines.en: : Yes, I mean the cafe. I say we go there sometime soon and give it a shot.
lines.zh: : 对，我说的是咖啡厅。我说我们找个时间去那儿试试。

lines.en: : Worse comes to worst, you don’t get hired and wind up with free lunch instead.
lines.zh: : 往最坏了想，你没被录用，最后也能白吃一顿午饭。

lines.en: : What if I do get hired, though?
lines.zh: : 可要是我真被录用了呢？

lines.en: : Not saying I will, of course. I mean...just fucking look at me.
lines.zh: : 当然，我不是说我会。我是说……你他妈看看我这副样子。

lines.en: : But what if I do get hired? I can’t be as friendly as Headphones. Or even half as nice.
lines.zh: : 可万一我真被录用了呢？我没法像 Headphones 那么亲切。连她一半的友善都做不到。

lines.en: y "I can’t even fuckin’ smile ninety-nine percent of the time. No one’s gonna
lines.zh: 「我他妈百分之九十九的时间连笑都笑不出来。

lines.en: want someone like that behind the counter."
lines.zh: 没人会想要一个那样的人站在柜台后面。」

lines.en: : So I’ll just wind up without a job again soon enough.
lines.zh: : 所以到头来我很快又会没工作。

lines.en: : And so you think it’s better to give up before you even try?
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得，还没试就先放弃更好？

lines.en: Yumi stays silent for a moment, likely pondering over the impact of my last sentence.
lines.zh: Yumi 沉默了一会儿，大概是在琢磨我最后那句话的分量。

lines.en: I’m not always the best when it comes to giving advice, but I’m pretty sure that I had the optimal response in this case.
lines.zh: 我不太擅长给人建议，但我很确定这次我的回应是最优解。

lines.en: The truth is, she’s got a point. There’s no way she can be as friendly as Rin. That’s not the type of person Yumi is.
lines.zh: 事实上，她说得有道理。她不可能像 Rin 那么亲切。Yumi 不是那种人。

lines.en: But that doesn’t mean she shouldn’t try.
lines.zh: 但这不代表她不该去试。

lines.en: Life is all about facing your fears and trying to accomplish the un-accomplishable.
lines.zh: 人生就是要直面恐惧，去尝试完成那些不可能完成的事。

lines.en: Or at least that's what it's supposed to be about.
lines.zh: 至少理应如此。

lines.en: For the rest of us, it's just...
lines.zh: 对我们其余的人来说，人生不过是……

lines.en: Trying to stay occupied, I guess?
lines.zh: 尽量让自己有事可做，我想？

lines.en: Filling a void?
lines.zh: 填补某个空洞？

lines.en: I don't know. This isn't really the time to get introspective.
lines.zh: 我不知道。现在真不是自我反省的时候。

lines.en: : ...Fine.
: I’ll come with you to the stupid cafe.
lines.zh: : 我陪你去那家破咖啡厅。

lines.en: : But you still have to buy me lunch when I don’t get hired. Got it?
lines.zh: : 但要是我没被录用，你还是得请我吃午饭。记住了？

lines.en: : Got it. We can go wherever you want.
lines.zh: : 记住了。你想去哪儿都行。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive18
: Wait...really? Anywhere?
lines.zh: : 等等……真的？哪儿都行？

lines.en: : You’re okay with spending that kind of money on me?
lines.zh: : 你愿意在我身上花那种钱？

lines.en: : I mean, I wish you’d be a little nicer to me every once in a while, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我倒是希望你偶尔能对我好一点，不过，是的。

lines.en: scene yumidormonefive19
: Um...cool. Okay. I guess if you’re okay with it then that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……行。好吧。既然你没问题，那就这样吧。

lines.en: y "I’ll try not to get too much, though. I know how much it sucks when you wind up
lines.zh: 「不过我会尽量少点一点。我知道最后堆出

lines.en: rackin’ up a bill you can’t afford."
lines.zh: 一张你付不起的账单，那感觉有多难受。」

lines.en: : Just get whatever you want and don’t even worry about it.
lines.zh: : 想点什么就点什么，完全别放在心上。

lines.en: : As long as you make a somewhat conscious effort at the cafe, I’ll be happy.
lines.zh: : 只要你在咖啡厅稍微用心试一试，我就很高兴了。

lines.en: : Okay.
: But I still fucking hate you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 可我还是他妈的恨你。记住了？

lines.en: : How could I possibly forget when you remind me every thirty seconds?
lines.zh: : 你每三十秒就提醒我一次，我怎么可能忘？

lines.en: scene black
I don’t stick around much longer after that.
lines.zh: 之后我没再待多久。

lines.en: I would have, but I guess Yumi got her fill of me and wanted to be alone again.
lines.zh: 我本来想多待一会儿，不过 Yumi 大概是受够我了，想一个人待着。

lines.en: Unfortunately for her, if this job-hunting thing is ever going to work out, she needs to force herself to accept my presence in at least slightly larger doses...
lines.zh: 对她来说不幸的是，如果找工作这件事真要成，她就得逼着自己接受更大量的我的存在……
